sloka: ध्वम्सयित्वा तु तद्वाक्यम् प्रमादात्पर्युपस्थितम् ।ह्लदनम् वचनम् सूतो देव्या मधुरमब्रवीत् ॥२-६०-१५॥
transliteration: dhvamsayitvā tu tadvākyam pramādātparyupasthitam ।hladanam vacanam sūto devyā madhuramabravīt ॥2-60-15॥

translations.english: Diverting the context of what he uttered inadvertently relating to Kaikeyi, the charioteer said pleasing words of consolation to Kausalya.
